cases.script: a=(outer tail); f(){ local a; a=(inner); printf '%s\n' "${a[@]}"; }; f; printf '%s\n' "${a[@]}"

cases.name: subshell and command substitution isolate array stores
dotglob, LET and stack share function state without loss
cases.script: a=(keep); shopt -s dotglob; pushd -n /other >/sink; let total=2+3; printf '%s|%s\n' "${a[0]}" "$total"; printf '<%s>\n' *; dirs -l -p

cases.name: array expansion feeds unchanged jq length
prefix scalar environment does not promote array members
cases.script: a=(base other); A=one printenv A; printf '%s|%s\n' "${a[0]}" "${A-unset}"
